Coverage · 28 decisions in the ledger · 15 stock · 13 option · 14 entries · 7
  exits · 4 index entries · 0 index exits · rule-originated, in no owner stream:
  lifecycle 1, proposal:trailing stop 2 · skipped: unsupported asset 2 ·
  unknown: history unavailable 6, immature 16
History · 11 names, 1 without history, 0 still to fetch · SPY 530 sessions

Reading · z is the underlying's move from the close of the fill's session, net
  of its market exposure, in units of its own daily noise; positive means the
  move went the decision's way. On an index (SPY, SPX, QQQ and the like, or a
  name that moves with SPY at R² 0.90 or more) z is the index's whole move in
  units of its whole daily noise. Entries (opens and adds) carry the gates;
  exits (trims and exits) and the index streams are reported, never gated. Each
  entry week counts once. The e-value is the weight of evidence for information
  in the decisions (100 is the bar); the posterior gives the chance the true
  mean z per week exceeds 0.05 and 0.10.
A sleeve is established only when every gate on its entries passes; until then
  nothing here says whether the decisions carry information. Fills made by
  Canary's rules or the broker's lifecycle are the rule sleeve and count for no
  one. Read-only review of past fills; it places no orders.
